div.style: color: rgb(90, 13, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RECOVERY: UI 'payment did not go through'; retry with same details reuses the order
webhook payment.failed marks the pending booking failed → seats released → waitlist offered
untouched holds expire after 30 min

div.style: color: rgb(90, 13, 13) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: ERROR: paid, but browser closed before verify

div.style: color: rgb(34, 34, 34) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
RECOVERY: razorpay-webhook settles independently · ticket email queued
booking appears in /dashboard

RECOVERY: unique payment_webhook_events.event_id → 200 duplicate
settle_payment already_confirmed · email dedupe key

admin refunds in Razorpay dashboard + admin_record_refund, or reseats
